response.original_title: NJPW Road to World Tag League 2026
response.overview: Road to World Tag League 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) on November 21, 2026, at Chichibunomiya Memorial Gymnasium in Fujisawa, Kanagawa, Japan. The event served as the sole preview show ahead of the annual World Tag League, NJPW's heavyweight tag team round-robin tournament.
